Leah (PM): Heads-up: need final call on Private deploy shape for next release. Topics: packaging format, upgrade handoff for customer-managed networks, and zero-downtime expectations. Who owns what?
Omar (Eng): Suggest MVP = single-package installer + handshake flow. Zero-downtime is hard across all environments; propose SLO: best-effort for zero-downtime, documented constraints.
Rina (Field): Customers insist on IP continuity for peering. Also want explicit opt-out of auto-upgrades in console.
Samir (NetOps): Technical note: IP continuity depends on BGP/session persistence or hostNetwork. We'll support a `preserve_ips` flag in manifest but must surface caveats.
Leah (PM): Decision proposal: ship handshake + snapshot rollback + manifest flag for `network.preserve_ips`. Explicitly call out 'best-effort' zero-downtime in docs.
Eve (CS): CS will produce: (1) rollback playbook, (2) customer contract blurb for IP retention, (3) short FAQ. Need legal approval for contract language.
infra-bot: infra-bot: nightly-build-2025.05.02  tests OK :white_check_mark:
Omar (Eng): Upgrade flow (short): validate manifest -> preflight -> KV snapshot -> optional cordon/drain -> run upgrade -> postchecks -> rollback if healthchecks fail. CLI example: `rw-upgrade --handshake-token TKN --preserve-ips`.
Rina (Field): I'll schedule 3 pilots (two cloud, one on-prem). We must capture exact failure modes during pilot.
Samir (NetOps): I'll draft handshake API: accepts token, ASN, CIDRs, requested window. Returns approval id and validation report. We'll log audit entries.
Leah (PM): Owners/dates: CS playbook by 2026-04-07, Eng impl by 2026-04-14, Docs by 2026-04-18. Freeze scope if no objections by EOD Fri.
Eve (CS): Starting draft, pinging Legal.
